svg.title: Contribution distribution, trailing 365 days
svg.desc: Daily contribution distribution over the trailing 365 days, Asia/Kuala Lumpur time. 1,168 contributions in total, active on 164 of 365 days (44.9%). The busiest single day was 91 contributions on 2026-08-18. Median 3 contributions per active day, longest quiet stretch 41 days. Composition: 1,053 commits, 70 pull requests, 2 issues, 1 private.
